lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs8La4Tl4F24 (reduced formula Cs2LaTlF6) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 225), with 40 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows La and Tl each adopt octahedral coordination by six F atoms, while Cs centers exhibit a close-packed-like arrangement with 12 F neighbors; the F centers have two geometric neighbors, one La and one Tl. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 40 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between La and Tl octahedra, and face-sharing between Cs and La as well as Cs and Tl polyhedra.
